summary: Select the canonical source claim for identical runtime-created mission revisions so independent updates converge across arrival order.

replay.detail: The existing person-work projection selects the earliest canonical source claim for a retained mission revision. Existing full replay can correct first-arrival provenance without replacing revision body, state or node-local creation index; no new replay trigger is added.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or storage-version change.

rules.detail: Claim admission, person authority, idempotency keys, run state and managed transaction guards are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client schema or API change. Identical runtime-created revisions use the same canonical claim order already used for published mission revisions.

downtime.detail: No restart or startup migration is required by the change. Existing full replays retain their work and writer lifetime.

manual.detail: No manual database repair or new operational command is required.

recovery.detail: Normal projection and existing full replay repair retained revision source selection inside the same transaction. Failure rolls back that selection; historical revision contents and creation indexes are preserved.
